verification_scope: Four workspace shells, route ownership, permission-filtered navigation, visible fallback/empty/error states, runtime/admin separation, and live DIRECT receipt display. It does not certify all B02 source-row business capabilities.
checks_actual_results: npm run build passed (vue-tsc and Vite; the pre-existing large-bundle warning remains).
Targeted Vitest run passed: 4 files, 25 tests, covering action outcome handling, permissions, routing and shell ownership.
git diff --check passed for the product frontend; only Git line-ending notices were emitted.
Live browser acceptance passed at 1440x900 for login, platform dashboard, platform tasks, platform administration, platform work configuration, system runtime and system administration.
Invalid platform and system URLs returned to the correct shell with a visible notice; browser console warnings/errors were empty.
A real DIRECT module create displayed the completed business receipt; the temporary business record was removed and its absence read back.
readback: Authenticated root entry resolves to /platform/dashboard instead of returning to login; platform tasks now remain inside PlatformShell.
Platform administration navigation and routes are filtered by each actual capability, including separate work and message configuration entry points.
System runtime navigation exposes business modules and runtime capabilities while work configuration lives in system administration.
Unknown workspace and route states render a usable ProductState or shell notice with return/retry actions instead of a blank page.
The independent runtime business-metrics navigation was removed; dashboards retain responsibility for statistics and trends.
At 1440x900 the verified platform/system pages had no horizontal overflow; long administration navigation scrolls inside its sidebar.
DIRECT actions without a Flow actionId now show a successful receipt using the returned server result.

permission_or_failure_result.route_and_permission_contract: Capability-specific tests passed for work runtime/configuration, messages, platform administration and denied-route fallbacks.
permission_or_failure_result.browser_identity: Local default platform super administrator; credentials were not written to evidence.
permission_or_failure_result.native_windows_backend: Could not serve the live journey because of the known XNIO loopback limitation; this was an environment startup failure, not counted as product acceptance.
permission_or_failure_result.linux_java21_backend: The same working tree ran through a Linux Maven/Java21 container with MySQL and Redis; the browser journey passed against it.

remaining: B02.2 still needs reusable list, filter, form, detail and action containers, with the runtime module and one fixed capability page migrated to them.
B02.3 still needs saved 1440x900 list, edit and detail reference screenshots; this step only used the viewport for live shell acceptance.
Disabled-system restricted administration and richer system-card identity/tenant/recent-access data depend on the B03 identity, membership and status contract; current runtime denial is explicit.
Lower-privilege navigation was contract-tested at the route/permission layer; the browser journey used the local default super administrator.
Advanced Flow, application, task and channel business behavior remains in their assigned packages; this evidence certifies shell ownership and routing only.
